title: Job Failure - product-catalog-glue-job (error file present)
description: Standard remediation for the product-catalog-glue-job. This job is diagnosed entirely from S3, not CloudWatch: when a run fails, the failed file is moved into the error/ folder of product-catalog-glue-job-654654277749. The presence of any file in that error/ folder is itself the failure signal - there is no step number or log content to parse. This job has no safe auto-remediation action; every match requires a human to review the file in error/ and decide how to proceed.
match_rule: Check whether the keyword bucket's (product-catalog-glue-job-654654277749) error/ folder currently contains one or more files. This is a plain presence check, not a diagnosis of the failure's root cause - any file found in error/ is sufficient to match. There is no step number, log file, or keyword content to evaluate.

example_log_events.description: A file landed in the error/ folder after a failed run - matches the rule
example_log_events.raw_event:
Bucket: product-catalog-glue-job-654654277749
Folder: error/
Files: product_catalog_20260716.csv
example_log_events.why: One or more files are present in error/, which alone is enough to trigger human intervention for this job - there is no auto-remediation action to attempt first.

decision_tree.name: Check the product-catalog-glue-job error/ folder for pending files
decision_tree.instruction: List the error/ folder of the keyword bucket (product-catalog-glue-job-654654277749). If it contains one or more files, human intervention is required.

conditions.if: one or more files exist in the keyword bucket's error/ folder
conditions.note: Any file present in error/ means the job failed and left unprocessed data behind. This job has no safe automated fix - send a human-intervention email stating that a file is present in the error folder and needs manual review.

feedback_notes: Unlike SOP-EAM-MMSO-701, this job has no step-number threshold and no safe auto-retry/file-move action - the mere presence of a file in error/ is sufficient to require human review, by design (auto_resolvable is false so every match always routes to a human regardless of confidence). Do not add an automated retry or file-move action for this job without updating this SOP and getting sign-off, since this SOP only detects that a file is present, not why the job failed.
